kn5000-87m: Wave 4 (lane kn5000-b, sub-lane tools), repo side done: scripts/analysis/parse_update_disc.py (commit 03e5bbcd5) prints the FAT12 view beside the firmware's view (Detect_Disk_Type's sector-0x21 signature against FILETYPE_SIG_*, the payload from sector 0x24 per type, both SLIDE4K streams of a type-7 disc decoded with the firmware's stop rule, the version byte at 0xFFFFE8) and identifies images by SHA-1 (program v5-v10, sub-CPU v1.40-v1.42, HD-AE5000 v1.10i-v2.06i); --extract writes files and payloads. On the v10 update disc: type 7, program v10 (0x0A), stream 2 = the v1.42 compressed sub-CPU image byte for byte, HKMSPRG.SLD is exactly the two streams. Type-6 path tested on a synthetic disc (notes/open4-kn5000-b/tools/probes/make_synthetic_type6.py). The disc carries no checksum and the firmware checks none. Only the v10 disc image is on this machine. Website page draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/tools/README.md section 3 (system-update-discs.md 'Reading an update disc'). Leave open until published.
kn5000-dkx: Wave 4 (lane kn5000-b, sub-lane tools), repo side done: Flash_EraseSectorWithBankSelect (0xEF3929) and Flash_ChipErase (0xEF387A) traced. Sequence AA/55/80/AA/55 at base+0xAAAA/0x5554 then 0x10 (chip) or 0x30 at address & 0xFF0000 (sector); A=1 IC19 0x300000, else HD-AE5000 0x280000; region 4: IC19 is two chips (second at 0x380000, command base +0x80000). Boot-block sub-sectors are added by extra 0x30 writes chosen by the device id at RAM 0x205E0/0x205E2 (0x2258 / 0x22AB bottom boot: +0x4000/+0x6000/+0x8000; otherwise top-sector sub-sectors; an extra sector erase when the address is exactly 0x3FFFFF). No read-back verification, no timeout: callers poll the ready line P7.5 forever; the type-7 handler issues its two sector erases back to back without polling (chip behaviour then not determined). Website page draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/tools/README.md section 4 (flash-programming.md). Leave open until published.
